summary: Make four notes' ketiv forms robust: where one letter has two vowels, put a CGJ (U+034F) between them, as MAM's Scripture text does, so that the order the note gives holds under any normalization or shaping engine. 2 Kgs 18:27: after the yod's sheva; Ezek 14:14, 14:20 (two forms) and 28:3: after the nun's ḥiriq

2Kings.comment: 2 Kings 18:27: the note's second א-כתיב form, in single guillemets, whose yod has a sheva and a tsere; CGJ after the yod's sheva
